events.title_en: Record crypto liquidation day: more than $19bn liquidated after the 100% China tariff threat
events.title_zh: 加密史上最大清算日：100% 对华关税威胁后超 190 亿美元被强平
facts: Trump posted the 100% China tariff threat on Truth Social at 20:50 UTC on Oct 10, 2025 (Galaxy Research)
More than $19bn of leveraged positions were liquidated in 24 hours across about 1.6 million accounts, roughly 87% of them longs (CoinGlass via Bitcoin.com / Galaxy)
$3.21bn was liquidated in a single minute at 21:15 UTC; BTC fell from $122,574 to $104,782 (Bitcoin.com, CoinGlass data)
Total perpetual futures open interest fell 43%, from $217bn to $123bn, in a day (CoinDesk Research)
The Nasdaq fell 3.6% and the S&P 500 2.7% that day (Galaxy Research)
USDe briefly traded at about $0.65 on Binance (Galaxy Research / CoinDesk Research)
BTC had set a record near $126,080 on Oct 6, 2025, four days earlier (Bitcoin.com)
facts_zh: 2025年10月10日 20:50 UTC，特朗普在 Truth Social 发帖威胁对中国加征100%关税（Galaxy）
24小时内超过190亿美元杠杆仓位被强平，约160万个账户，约87%是多头（CoinGlass，经 Bitcoin.com / Galaxy）
21:15 UTC 一分钟内清算32.1亿美元；BTC 从122574美元跌到104782美元（Bitcoin.com，CoinGlass 数据）
永续合约总持仓一天内下降43%，从2170亿美元降到1230亿美元（CoinDesk Research）
USDe 在币安一度跌到约0.65美元（Galaxy / CoinDesk Research）
四天前的10月6日 BTC 创下约126080美元的历史新高（Bitcoin.com）
